title: CRISPR Screen Design for T Cell Exhaustion Regulators: A Systematic Approach to Identify 32 Target Genes

contributions.purpose: 提出透明评分的基因优先级算法
contributions.mechanism: Combined Score=w1·强制核心(4.0)+w2·基因集支持(1.0)+w3·DepMap 必需性归一(2.0),含权重敏感性分析
contributions.evaluation: 定性:强制核心基因(PDCD1/TOX 等)获满分;基因集支持均值 127±156(范围 0-689)
contributions.domain: CRISPR 筛选设计/肿瘤免疫
contributions.source_quote: We developed a transparent scoring algorithm to rank candidate genes: Combined Score = w1 * Forced Core + w2 * Support Total + w3 * DepMap Score

contributions.purpose: 产出 T 细胞耗竭调控 32 基因面板
contributions.mechanism: 整合文献+DepMap 必需性+MSigDB/MouseMine 富集,跨免疫检查点/转录/代谢/表观分类
contributions.evaluation: 称 32 基因;DepMap 均值效应 -0.16 至 -0.12,无极端必需(< -1.5)基因
contributions.source_quote: We identified 32 target genes spanning immune checkpoints (PDCD1, CTLA4, HAVCR2, LAG3, TIGIT), master transcriptional regulators (TOX, NR4A1, BATF, PRDM1)

contributions.purpose: 提供可执行的混合 CRISPR 筛选协议
contributions.mechanism: 库组成(128 靶向+100 非靶+8 阳性=236 guide)、MOI 0.3、1000 细胞/guide 覆盖、1000 reads/guide/样本、sgRNA 设计规则
contributions.evaluation: 定量规格:总测序需求 1.9M reads,预估 910,000 细胞
contributions.source_quote: We developed a quantitative screening protocol specifying cell coverage (1000 cells/guide), transduction parameters (MOI 0.3), and sequencing depth requirements

self_declared_provenance.quote: Compared to prior candidate-based studies, this pipeline reduces bias by integrating diverse datasets and applying transparent scoring.

notes: 纯计算"筛选设计"论文,无湿实验验证(自述局限)。数据红旗:核心"32 基因"与正文列表不符——3.1 列出 免疫检查点 6 + 转录调控 13(标称11)+ 代谢 5 + 表观 5 + 信号 3 + Other 2 = 34,且 SIRT1 在代谢与 Other 两处重复计数,"32"这一标题级数字不自洽。参考文献仅 7 条,arXiv:2409.12345(Brown & Chen 2024)形似占位/伪造 ID。checklist 全 [D]:AI 自主提出假设、设计、分析、写作(bioPLE/BioPLE 框架);人类仅解决 LaTeX 编译。type 以 method+resource 为主,无实证 finding。
